blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: The deletion filter returns budget_2030, budget_2031 and must_P017 for an infeasible request. What does that result promise?

options.text: No plan meets all three, and without any one of them a plan exists
options.says: Right: the set is irreducible, so drop or change any one and a plan exists.

options.text: Every plan breaks all three, and each of them must change at once
options.says: Changing any one of the three is enough.

options.text: These are the only rows the filter solved the model for, once each
options.says: The filter solves once per row of the model, up to 50 on GridCap small.

options.text: Relaxing budget_2030 on its own leaves the model still infeasible
options.says: Each row in the set is needed: relaxing any one of them gives a plan.

origin.section: Relax One Named Row at a Time to Find the Rows That Clash

questions.stem: Forcing a deferred project in gives a plan that is worth $300k less NPV than the base plan. What does steps/06 report for that project?

options.text: The rows that clash, since a forcing that lowers NPV breaks a rule
options.says: A forced plan that exists breaks no row; rows are reported only when forcing is infeasible.

options.text: The NPV it costs and the projects the forced plan leaves out
options.says: Right: why_deferred prices a feasible forcing and lists the displaced projects.

options.text: The rows that block it, found with the forcing row relaxed first
options.says: Blocking rows are reported only when forcing is infeasible, and the forcing row is kept.

options.text: The base plan again, since the forced plan is worth less NPV
options.says: why_deferred reports the forced plan's NPV cost and the projects it drops, as for P030.

origin.section: The Messages Name the Rules and the Numbers

questions.stem: A new rule adds rows named cap_Coast. What must change so the diagnostics describe those rows in the planners' words?

options.text: Nothing, since the filter prints each rule function's docstring
options.says: describe builds each sentence from the row name, one branch per prefix.

options.text: The deletion filter, which skips any rows it has no words for
options.says: The filter relaxes every row in name order, whatever its prefix.

options.text: A branch in describe for the new prefix, as every rule has had
options.says: Right: describe is a chain of if branches, one per row prefix.

options.text: The rule itself, which must hand its message to the filter
options.says: Rules only add rows through built.add; describe owns the words.

origin.section: Diagnostics Were the Largest Step So Far, and Changed No Model Code

concepts: what a new row prefix needs in diagnostics
